title: Dealer visits and dealership handling
summary: This topic centers on customers bringing vehicles to dealers for inspection, diagnosis, repairs, or explanations, with most sampled fragments describing the interaction without a clear evaluative outcome.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe dealers fixing issues or providing service-related help, though the examples are limited and sometimes phrased ambiguously.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention poor dealership quality, ongoing diagnosis, or dealer-related problem handling, though some sampled examples conflict with their assigned sentiment and limit specificity.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly note that the vehicle was brought to a dealer, was inspected or serviced, or involved waiting for parts or dealer follow-up without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the topic is dominated by process descriptions rather than clear opinions.
Several supplied examples appear sentiment-ambiguous or inconsistent with their assigned labels, which limits confidence in summarizing concrete positive or negative themes.
The topic is broad and may combine routine dealer visits, repair progress updates, and dealership competence issues rather than a single coherent experience theme.
